Title: Organic Hydroponic Nutrients: Yields, Problems & Fixes
Description: Organic hydroponic nutrients work but yield less: lettuce 9–77% less in trials, strawberries 15%. Aerate, time the pump and add calcium and magnesium. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic nutrients organic, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic nutrients
